products.name: High-Power Semiconductor Lasers
products.description: nLIGHT designs, manufactures, and sells high-power semiconductor lasers, which are physically manufactured using compound semiconductor laser chips and are typically integrated into customers' laser systems or manufacturing tools for aerospace, defense, and microfabrication applications.

products.name: High-Power Fiber Lasers
products.description: nLIGHT offers programmable and serviceable high-power fiber lasers, manufactured using proprietary active fiber technology, for use in industrial, aerospace, and defense applications including material processing, directed energy, and sensing.

products.name: Fiber Amplifiers
products.description: nLIGHT designs, manufactures, and sells high-performance fiber amplifiers that amplify optical signals within optical fibers, providing high power outputs and superior beam quality for aerospace, defense, and industrial applications.

products.name: Beam Combination and Control Systems
products.description: nLIGHT manufactures beam combination and control systems, which are integrated into high-energy laser systems for directed energy and laser sensing, enabling advanced beam shaping and control for defense and industrial customers.

products.name: Custom and Next-Generation Laser Solutions (Advanced Development)
products.description: Through its Advanced Development segment, nLIGHT provides custom high-power fiber lasers and advanced laser technologies, including prototyping and research services, primarily for governmental and defense agencies seeking next-generation directed energy and sensing solutions.

products.name: Levi's Jeans and Jeanswear
products.description: A wide spectrum of jeans and jeanswear, including various fits, fabrics, finishes, styles, and price points for men, women, and children, manufactured primarily through independent contract manufacturers and sold globally through wholesale, retail, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Levi's Lifestyle Apparel (Non-Jeans)
products.description: Non-jeans apparel under the Levi's brand, including casual and dress pants, tops, shorts, skirts, dresses, jackets, and related accessories, produced via contract manufacturing and distributed through global retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Levi Strauss Signature Apparel
products.description: Value-focused jeans, casual pants, tops, and jackets for men, women, and children, produced for mass retail channels primarily in the United States and Canada, manufactured through contract manufacturers.

products.name: Beyond Yoga Athleisure Apparel
products.description: Premium athleisure and activewear apparel, including leggings, tops, and related products, focused on comfort and inclusivity, produced with soft, easy-care fabrics and sold primarily in the United States through specialty retailers, company-operated stores, and e-commerce.

products.name: Dockers Casual Apparel (Discontinued/Sold)
products.description: Casual pants and related apparel under the Dockers brand, historically focused on men's casualwear, produced via contract manufacturing and distributed globally through retail and wholesale channels; business sold in 2025-2026.

products.name: Denizen Apparel (Discontinued)
products.description: Value-oriented jeans and casual apparel under the Denizen brand, previously sold through wholesale accounts in the United States, produced via contract manufacturing; brand discontinued in 2025.

products.name: Investment Accounting Solutions
products.description: Cloud-native, multi-asset class, multi-basis, multi-currency investment accounting software that automates operational and regulatory accounting, reconciliation, and reporting for institutional investors. Delivered as SaaS, it replaces legacy on-premises systems and manual processes.

products.name: Portfolio and Order Management Platform
products.description: Integrated cloud-native platform combining portfolio management, order execution, analytics, and compliance, enabling clients to construct portfolios, run compliance checks, and execute trades electronically across asset classes. Delivered via web interface with real-time data and workflow automation.

products.name: Risk and Performance Analytics Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive suite of cross-asset risk management and performance measurement tools, including real-time exposure monitoring, stress testing, scenario analysis, and performance attribution. Delivered as SaaS, leveraging cloud infrastructure and AI for analytics.

products.name: Alternative Asset Management Solutions
products.description: Integrated solutions for private funds and private credit, automating data aggregation, accounting, risk, compliance, and reporting for alternative investments such as limited partnerships, private credit, mortgages, and derivatives. Delivered as SaaS with specialized modules for private assets.

products.name: Reporting and Data Distribution Solutions
products.description: Modular, SaaS-based data and reporting platform that aggregates, validates, and normalizes investment, accounting, performance, and risk data from multiple sources, enabling highly customized client and regulatory reports accessible via web interface or automated feeds.

products.name: Compliance and Regulatory Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Automated compliance monitoring tools embedded in the platform, providing pre- and post-trade compliance, regulatory rule sets, violation tracking, and audit trails for investment portfolios. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform, supporting global regulatory regimes.

products.name: AI-Enabled Investment Operations Automation
products.description: Embedded AI and machine learning capabilities within the platform, automating reconciliation, reporting, variance analysis, and other investment operations tasks to reduce manual effort and accelerate decision-making. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform with configurable AI agents and workflows.

products.name: Prescription Price Comparison Platform
products.description: A digital platform that aggregates and normalizes prescription pricing data from PBMs, pharmacies, and manufacturers, allowing consumers to compare prices and access negotiated discounts at nearly every retail pharmacy in the U.S. via GoodRx codes. Delivered via web and mobile apps, requires proprietary data processing and integration with healthcare industry stakeholders.

products.name: Prescription Savings Subscription Programs
products.description: Subscription-based offerings (e.g., Gold, RxSmartSaver+, condition-specific subscriptions) that provide members with enhanced prescription discounts, mail delivery, and bundled care for select medications and conditions, for a monthly or annual fee. Delivered digitally and through partnerships with select pharmacies, includes bundled telehealth and delivery for some programs.

products.name: Telehealth Services
products.description: Digital telehealth platform (GoodRx Care) offering cash-pay virtual visits with clinicians for various conditions, including bundled care in some subscriptions. Delivered online, supported by third-party clinician networks, and integrated with prescription and delivery services.

products.name: Pharma Direct Solutions
products.description: Advertising and integration services for pharmaceutical manufacturers to promote and deliver affordability solutions (e.g., co-pay cards, patient assistance, direct pricing) for brand medications to consumers via the GoodRx platform. Delivered digitally, leveraging GoodRx's consumer base and data integrations.

products.name: Prescription Delivery Services
products.description: Facilitation of prescription home delivery for eligible medications, available as part of certain subscription programs and through partnerships with pharmacies. Delivered via mail through third-party pharmacy partners, integrated with digital platform.

products.name: Healthcare Educational Content
products.description: Provision of expert medication information, health articles, and pricing/coverage resources to consumers through the GoodRx platform, aimed at improving healthcare literacy and decision-making. Delivered digitally via web and mobile apps.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of crude oil produced from unconventional, onshore reserves in the Permian Basin, primarily through horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing. The product is physically produced, gathered, and sold to external customers via established infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas from unconventional, onshore reserves in the Permian Basin, utilizing horizontal drilling and completion techniques. The product is physically produced, processed, and delivered to external customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as ethane, propane, and butane, produced as byproducts from oil and gas wells in the Permian Basin. NGLs are separated and sold to external customers.

products.name: Mineral and Royalty Interests
products.description: Ownership and sale of mineral and royalty interests, primarily through the Viper subsidiary, which entitles the company to a share of production revenues from third-party operated wells. These interests are acquired, held, and monetized through sales or royalty income.

products.name: Custom and Standard Vehicular and Industrial Hardware
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets a diverse line of custom and standard hardware products such as latches, hinges, camlocks, key switches, padlocks, and handles for vehicular and industrial applications. Production involves physical manufacturing and engineering tailored to OEM and industrial customer needs.

products.name: Turnkey Returnable Packaging Solutions
products.description: Designs and manufactures custom returnable transport packaging for integration with OEM assembly processes in vehicles, aircraft, and durable goods. Involves engineering and physical production to meet specific customer requirements.

products.name: Blow Mold Tooling and Related Components
products.description: Designs and manufactures blow mold tools, injection blow mold tooling, and related components for the production of plastic packaging and packaged consumer goods, serving industries such as food, beverage, healthcare, and chemicals. Production is highly engineered and involves precision manufacturing.

products.name: Access and Security Hardware Systems
products.description: Provides engineered access and security hardware, including both standard and custom electromechanical and mechanical systems, for OEMs and a wide range of applications. Involves engineering, manufacturing, and program management services.

products.name: Vision Technology and Aftermarket Components for Commercial Vehicles
products.description: Designs and manufactures proprietary vision technology products such as mirrors and mirror-cameras, as well as aftermarket components for heavy-duty trucks, motorhomes, and buses. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to OEM and aftermarket customers.

products.name: EKTERLY (sebetralstat) Oral Therapy for Hereditary Angioedema (HAE)
products.description: A novel, orally delivered, small molecule plasma kallikrein inhibitor tablet for the on-demand treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older. Manufactured as an oral tablet and distributed through pharmaceutical channels, with global commercialization efforts including licensing to partners in select markets.

products.name: Sebetralstat Orally Disintegrating Tablet (ODT) for Pediatric HAE
products.description: An orally disintegrating tablet formulation of sebetralstat developed specifically for pediatric patients aged 2 to 11 years old for the on-demand treatment of acute HAE attacks. Manufactured as an ODT for ease of administration in children, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Oral Factor XIIa Inhibitor Drug Candidates
products.description: Preclinical oral Factor XIIa inhibitor program targeting a range of indications supported by scientific evidence. These are small molecule drugs under development, with potential for oral administration, currently in preclinical or early clinical stages.

products.name: Mutual Fund Management Services
products.description: Management and investment advisory services for a family of 16 open-end mutual funds (the Hennessy Mutual Funds), including portfolio management, compliance, marketing, and distribution. These services are delivered through a combination of in-house and sub-advised management, requiring financial expertise, regulatory compliance, and ongoing fund administration.

products.name: Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) Management Services
products.description: Management and investment advisory services for exchange-traded funds (ETFs), specifically the Hennessy Sustainable ETF and planned additional ETFs, including portfolio construction, compliance, and distribution. These services are delivered digitally via regulated ETF structures and require financial expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Shareholder Services for Mutual Fund Investors
products.description: Provision of shareholder services to investors in the Hennessy Mutual Funds, including account support via a toll-free number and acting as a liaison with the fund administrator. These services are delivered through in-person and telephonic support and require human labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Innovative Medicines
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products developed and manufactured for a range of therapeutic areas including oncology, immunology, neuroscience, pulmonary hypertension, infectious diseases, and cardiovascular/metabolism. These medicines are distributed to retailers, wholesalers, hospitals, and healthcare professionals for prescription use and require significant R&D, regulatory approval, and manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Cardiovascular MedTech Products
products.description: Medical devices and technologies for cardiovascular care, including electrophysiology products, mechanical circulatory support, circulatory restoration, and neurovascular care. These are primarily delivered through minimally invasive, catheter-based approaches and used by interventional cardiologists and specialists in hospitals and clinics.

products.name: Orthopaedics Products
products.description: Devices and enabling technologies supporting joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, and sports-related injuries. These products are manufactured and distributed to hospitals and surgical centers, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical support.

products.name: Surgical Products and Technologies
products.description: A range of surgical products and enabling technologies for open, laparoscopic, and robotic procedures, including instrumentation, energy devices, stapling systems, wound closure, biosurgery products, and digital/robotic technologies. These are manufactured and distributed to hospitals and surgical centers globally.

products.name: Vision Care Products
products.description: Products for corrective and surgical vision care, including ACUVUE contact lenses, TECNIS premium intraocular lenses for cataract surgery, and other devices used in cataract and refractive procedures. These are manufactured and distributed to eye care professionals and ophthalmic surgeons.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including construction and development loans, primarily delivered through in-person banking relationships and regulated lending infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to businesses for working capital, equipment, and other business purposes, delivered through relationship banking and subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Equipment Finance and Leasing
products.description: Origination of equipment finance leases for business customers, involving underwriting, asset evaluation, and ongoing lease management, delivered through specialized finance teams.

products.name: Municipal Leasing
products.description: Provision of municipal leases to government entities, typically for equipment or infrastructure, delivered through a dedicated municipal lease subsidiary and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans secured by first and second mortgages on one-to-four family residences, including home equity loans, delivered through branch and digital channels and subject to consumer lending regulations.

products.name: Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs)
products.description: Origination of home equity lines of credit, including those pooled and sold to third parties, delivered through branch and digital channels with regulated underwriting.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Origination and sale of SBA-guaranteed loans to small businesses, involving specialized underwriting and compliance with SBA requirements, with some loans sold to third parties.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of various consumer loans other than mortgages and HELOCs, such as personal loans, delivered through branch and digital channels and subject to consumer protection regulations.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts for individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations, including checking, savings, and certificates of deposit, delivered through branch, online, and mobile channels and supported by regulated deposit insurance.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provision of cash management solutions tailored to small and mid-sized commercial business customers, including online and mobile banking, delivered through digital platforms and supported by internal expertise.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment in and management of debt securities, including U.S. government agency securities, municipal bonds, corporate bonds, and certificates of deposit, primarily for the bank's own portfolio but may include sales to customers.

products.name: Prescription Generic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and marketing of generic prescription drugs for a wide range of high-incidence and high-mortality diseases, including cardiovascular, central nervous system, infectious, and digestive diseases. Products are produced in various forms such as tablets, capsules, injectables, and powders at GMP-compliant facilities and sold primarily to hospitals and pharmacies in China.

products.name: Modern Traditional Chinese Medicines (TCMs)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of modernized, plant-based Traditional Chinese Medicines using advanced production techniques, offered in forms such as tablets, capsules, or powders. These are approved for therapeutic indications and marketed as alternatives or complements to synthetic drugs.

products.name: Comprehensive Healthcare Products
products.description: Production and sale of health and nutrition supplements, such as Noni enzyme, targeting consumer health improvement and wellness. These products are manufactured in dedicated lines and marketed to individuals seeking health benefits outside of prescription drugs.

products.name: Protective Products (Masks and Sanitizers)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of protective products including medical masks (KN95, N95, disposable, particulate respirators) and alcohol-based sanitizers. These are produced in compliance with national standards and distributed to healthcare institutions and consumers, especially in response to epidemic demand.

products.name: Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) Services
products.description: Provision of contract development and manufacturing services for pharmaceutical preparations, covering the full lifecycle from preclinical and clinical trials to scale-up manufacturing and commercialization. Services leverage the company's GMP-certified facilities and expertise in pharmaceutical R&D and production.

products.name: Automotive Aftermarket Parts and Maintenance Items
products.description: A broad range of new and remanufactured automotive hard parts and maintenance items, including alternators, batteries, brake system components, belts, chassis parts, engine parts, filters, fluids, lighting, oil, wiper blades, and more, sold through physical stores and online platforms to both DIY and professional customers. These products are sourced from national brands and proprietary private labels, requiring extensive inventory management and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Automotive Accessories
products.description: A selection of automotive accessories such as floor mats, seat covers, and truck accessories, sold through retail stores and online channels. These are typically manufactured goods distributed via the company's supply chain.

products.name: Automotive Tools and Equipment
products.description: A range of automotive tools and equipment, including loaner tools, diagnostic devices, and shop equipment, provided for sale or temporary use to customers. These are distributed through stores and supported by inventory and logistics systems.

products.name: Automotive Paint and Refinishing Products
products.description: Professional paint shop mixing and related materials, including automotive paints and refinishing supplies, offered to professional service providers and DIY customers. These products require specialized in-store mixing and inventory management.

products.name: Automotive Diagnostic and Testing Services
products.description: In-store diagnostic and testing services such as battery diagnostic testing, electrical and module testing, and check engine light code extraction using proprietary technology. These services are performed by trained staff using specialized equipment at retail locations.

products.name: Automotive Parts Installation Assistance
products.description: Basic installation assistance services for items such as batteries, wipers, and bulbs, performed in-store by staff for customers. This service is labor-based and delivered at the point of sale.

products.name: Automotive Parts Resurfacing and Custom Fabrication Services
products.description: In-store services including drum and rotor resurfacing and custom hydraulic hose fabrication, using specialized equipment and trained personnel. These services are provided at select store locations.

products.name: Automotive Recycling Services
products.description: Collection and recycling of used oil, oil filters, and automotive batteries from customers, facilitated at store locations and processed by third-party recyclers. This service is provided to comply with environmental regulations and support customer needs.

products.name: Online Automotive Parts and Accessories Sales
products.description: Digital sales of automotive parts, accessories, and related products through proprietary online platforms for both professional and DIY customers, with options for in-store pickup or home delivery. This is a digital-only channel leveraging the company's inventory and logistics network.

products.name: Reed’s Craft Ginger Beer
products.description: A line of craft ginger beers made with pressed organic ginger and natural ingredients, available in multiple spice levels and sweetener options. Produced through independent co-packers and distributed nationally and internationally.

products.name: Reed’s Real Ginger Ale
products.description: A ginger ale line made with pressed organic ginger and natural ingredients, offered in regular and zero sugar varieties, including seasonal flavors. Manufactured by co-packers and distributed through various retail channels.

products.name: Reed’s Ready to Drink Alcoholic Beverages
products.description: Ready-to-drink alcoholic beverages including Classic Mule and Hard Ginger Ale, made with pressed organic ginger, available in multiple flavors and sold in select states. Produced via co-packers and distributed through alcohol retail channels.

products.name: Reed’s Functional Soda
products.description: A multi-functional soda line formulated with organic ginger, adaptogen mushroom extracts, and prebiotic fiber, positioned as a health-oriented beverage. Manufactured by co-packers and distributed through retail and specialty channels.

products.name: Virgil’s Handcrafted Soda
products.description: A premium line of handcrafted sodas using natural ingredients, available in classic flavors and zero sugar options. Produced by co-packers and distributed through grocery, specialty, and mass retail channels.

products.name: Flying Cauldron Soda
products.description: A non-alcoholic butterscotch beer made with natural ingredients, free from artificial flavors and preservatives. Produced by co-packers and distributed to beverage retailers and specialty outlets.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: The company provides a broad range of lending services, including real estate loans (commercial, construction, multifamily, agricultural, and residential), commercial loans (including small business and SBA loans), mortgage warehouse lending, agricultural production loans, and consumer loans. These services require significant financial capital, regulatory compliance, and in-person relationship management, and are delivered through branch offices and loan production offices.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: The company offers a wide range of deposit products and services for individuals and businesses, including checking accounts, savings accounts, money market demand accounts, time deposits, retirement accounts, and sweep accounts. These are delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels, and are insured by the FDIC.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: The company provides digital banking services such as online account opening, online banking with bill-pay, mobile banking (including mobile check deposit), and online lending solutions. These services are delivered digitally and require investment in technology infrastructure and cybersecurity.

products.name: ATM and Payment Network Access
products.description: The company offers customers access to ATMs at nearly all branch and select non-branch locations, as well as surcharge-free access to over 55,000 ATMs via the Allpoint network and electronic point-of-sale payment alternatives via the Pulse network. This service is delivered through physical and networked infrastructure.

products.name: Remote Deposit Capture and Payroll Services
products.description: The company offers remote deposit capture and payroll services to business customers, enabling them to deposit checks and manage payroll electronically. These services are delivered through digital platforms and require technology integration and support.

products.name: TrueCut Motion Platform
products.description: A software-based platform providing content creation tools, motion grading services, and IP licensing for filmmakers, studios, and display brands to customize and preserve cinematic motion appearance across all screens. Delivered as software tools, services, and IP licensing, not requiring physical manufacturing.

products.name: Corporate Payments Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital payment and spend management products for businesses, including AP automation, cross-border payments (with FX and hedging), virtual cards, and purchasing/T&E card programs. Delivered via proprietary platforms, APIs, and integrations with ERP/accounting systems, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Vehicle Payments Solutions
products.description: Digital payment solutions for vehicle-related expenses, including fuel cards (for all fuel types, including EV charging), toll and parking payments, vehicle compliance, auto insurance, and fleet maintenance. Delivered via proprietary and third-party networks, mobile/web apps, and SaaS platforms, requiring regulated payment infrastructure and partnerships with merchants and OEMs.

products.name: Lodging Payments Solutions
products.description: Payment and management solutions for business, airline, and insurance-related lodging needs, including hotel and extended stay bookings, temporary housing, and travel support. Delivered via proprietary and third-party hotel networks, integrated with customer systems, and supported by data management and payment processing platforms.

products.name: Gift Card Program Management and Processing
products.description: Turnkey management and processing of branded gift card programs for retailers, in both plastic and digital forms, including card design, production, fulfillment, transaction processing, analytics, and distribution. Delivered via proprietary systems and networks, requiring payment processing infrastructure.

products.name: Payroll Card Solutions
products.description: Reloadable stored value payroll cards for employees, operating on major payment networks and ATM networks, as an alternative to paper payroll checks. Delivered via proprietary and partner infrastructure, requiring regulatory compliance and integration with employer payroll systems.

products.name: Employee Benefits Payment Solutions
products.description: Prepaid food and transportation cards and vouchers for employees, primarily in Brazil and Mexico, usable at restaurants, grocery stores, and for public transportation. Delivered via payment card infrastructure and merchant networks, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Digital Customer Experience Services
products.description: Omnichannel customer care, sales and customer acquisition, new product/market launches, and digital CX consulting delivered via cloud-based infrastructure, leveraging both human talent and automation across digital and voice channels.

products.name: Trust & Safety Services
products.description: Content moderation and financial crime & compliance services for online platforms, including policy development, content review, fraud detection, identity verification, and regulatory compliance, delivered by specialized teams using proprietary technology and human expertise.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence Services
products.description: Data annotation, labeling, collection, model evaluation, AI deployment management, and AI safety services supporting the machine learning lifecycle, delivered by specialized teams using proprietary tools and human-in-the-loop processes.

products.name: Freight Rail Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of raw materials, intermediate products, and finished goods via a major freight railroad network across the Southeast, East, Midwest, and through interchange to the rest of the U.S. and ports. Service is provided using owned and leased locomotives and railcars over a capital-intensive, regulated rail infrastructure.

products.name: Merchandise Freight Transportation
products.description: Rail transportation of diverse bulk and manufactured goods, including agriculture, forest and consumer products, chemicals, metals and construction materials, and automotive products. Delivered using specialized railcars and infrastructure to manufacturing plants, distribution centers, and other facilities.

products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Rail-based movement of domestic and international containers and trailers on behalf of intermodal marketing companies, steamship lines, and other customers. Requires specialized intermodal equipment (chassis, containers) and extensive terminal infrastructure.

products.name: Coal Transportation Services
products.description: Rail transportation of coal from major eastern and western coal basins to electric generation plants, export terminals, and industrial customers. Delivered using dedicated coal railcars and direct access to river, lake, and coastal facilities.

products.name: Interconnect Products and Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets a broad range of electrical, electronic, and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, including high-speed, radio frequency, power, and fiber optic interconnects, as well as value-add cable assemblies and harnesses. These products are physically manufactured and assembled in global facilities and delivered to OEMs and service providers.

products.name: Specialty and High-Performance Cables
products.description: Produces coaxial, fiber optic, power, and specialty cables for use in communications, industrial, automotive, and other applications. These cables are manufactured using advanced processes and supplied to external customers worldwide.

products.name: Antennas and Antenna Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures antennas for consumer devices, network infrastructure, automotive, and communications networks, including base station antennas and distributed antenna systems. These are physically produced and supplied to OEMs and network operators.

products.name: Sensors and Sensor-Based Products
products.description: Develops and manufactures a wide range of sensors and sensor-based systems for applications such as force, gas, moisture, level, position, pressure, temperature, and vibration. These are integrated into automotive, industrial, and other systems and require specialized manufacturing and testing.

products.name: Printed Circuit Boards and Assemblies
products.description: Manufactures flexible and rigid printed circuit boards and printed circuit assemblies for use in harsh environments, aerospace, defense, and industrial applications. These are produced in certified facilities and supplied to OEMs.

products.name: Backplane and Power Distribution Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures backplane interconnect systems and busbars for power distribution in data centers, industrial, and communications equipment. These are complex assemblies requiring precision manufacturing and system integration.

products.name: Cable Management Products
products.description: Produces cable management solutions including wire bundling, cable management assemblies, and related accessories for aerospace, industrial, and communications infrastructure. These are manufactured and delivered as part of integrated systems.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence Solutions
products.description: Secure, purpose-built AI solutions adapted from commercial and internally-developed technology, delivered primarily to federal government customers. These solutions are developed and deployed by technologists and mission experts to address unique government needs.

products.name: Cybersecurity Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive cyber solutions including intelligence-grade technology and advanced tradecraft to defend critical assets for federal and commercial customers. Delivery involves technical expertise and deployment of secure systems and practices.

products.name: Digital Transformation Services
products.description: Modernization of legacy systems through cloud-enabled infrastructure, platforms, and applications, focusing on enterprise digital transformation for government and commercial clients. Services are delivered by technical teams with deep mission understanding.

products.name: Space and ISR Solutions
products.description: Space-focused solutions including large-scale multi-modal data fusion, cyber, and AI for secure, rapid, enhanced Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), earth observation, and domain awareness/battle management. Delivered by space experts and technologists.

products.name: Quantum Technology Solutions
products.description: Research, development, and delivery of quantum information sciences solutions, including quantum computing, sensing, communications, post-quantum compute readiness, and cryptography. Solutions are developed by technologists for government and commercial adoption.

products.name: Mission-Focused Technology Consulting
products.description: Consulting services that blend advanced technical expertise, market-leading innovation, and deep mission understanding to solve complex problems for defense, intelligence, and civil government customers. Delivered by multifaceted teams with domain and technical expertise.

products.name: Integrated Flight Deck Systems
products.description: These are comprehensive cockpit solutions (COCKPIT/IP®) including primary flight/navigation displays, crew alerting and engine displays, integrated standby instruments, and mission displays. They are physically manufactured, assembled, and integrated for both retrofit and OEM applications.

products.name: Navigation Systems
products.description: These systems include flight management systems, mission computers, navigation radios, and transponders. They are developed, manufactured, and integrated into aircraft for both new builds and retrofits, requiring regulatory certification and physical installation.

products.name: Communication Systems
products.description: This product line includes communication radios, audio panels, and radio management units, which are manufactured and integrated into aircraft for voice and data communication. These are sold to OEMs and retrofit customers and require regulatory compliance.

products.name: Sensors and Control Systems
products.description: This includes air data computers, attitude and heading reference systems, magnetometers, inertial reference units, GPS receivers, utility management systems, and flight control computers. These are precision-manufactured, tested, and integrated into aircraft systems for flight control and data measurement.

products.name: Advanced Flight Actuators
products.description: This line includes linear and rotary smart-actuators for movement of aircraft levers and surfaces, such as the ThrustSense® Autothrottle system. These are engineered, manufactured, and integrated into aircraft for both OEM and retrofit applications.

products.name: Avionics Product Support and Services
products.description: This includes repair, overhaul, and lifecycle support services for the company's avionics products and systems, provided to both OEM and retrofit customers. Services are delivered through in-house technical teams and certified facilities.

products.name: Regulated Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Atmos Energy delivers natural gas to residential, commercial, public authority, and industrial customers through regulated distribution systems across eight states. This service involves the physical delivery of natural gas via company-owned pipelines and infrastructure, under rates set by state regulatory authorities.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation Services
products.description: Atmos Energy transports natural gas for third parties, including local distribution companies, industrial and electric generation customers, marketers, and producers, using its regulated pipeline network. This service is provided under firm transportation agreements and is subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Natural Gas Storage Services
products.description: Atmos Energy offers regulated underground natural gas storage services, primarily through its Atmos Pipeline-Texas division, which owns and operates multiple storage facilities. These services are provided to both internal divisions and third-party customers, supporting supply flexibility and reliability.

products.name: Bioprocessing Technologies and Solutions
products.description: Equipment, consumables, software, and services supporting the development and manufacture of biological medicines, including cell line and media development, filtration, chromatography, single-use hardware, and full manufacturing suite design and installation. Delivered through physical manufacturing, technical services, and digital solutions to biomanufacturers and related organizations.

products.name: Biotherapeutic Research and Medical Filtration Solutions
products.description: Products and services for biotherapeutic research, sample preparation, diagnostic assay development, and healthcare filtration, including lab filtration, separation, purification, analytical tools, reagents, membranes, and sterility solutions for medical liquids and gases. Delivered via physical products and technical services to research and healthcare institutions.

products.name: Life Sciences Instruments
products.description: A broad range of laboratory instruments including centrifugation, automated liquid handling, flow cytometry, mass spectrometry, and microscopy systems, used for research, drug discovery, and manufacturing. These are manufactured physical devices, often integrated with software and consumables, delivered to scientific, medical, and industrial customers.

products.name: Life Sciences Consumables and Genomic/Proteomic Reagents
products.description: Consumables and reagents such as antibodies, assays, plasmid DNA, RNA, nucleic acids, proteins, and gene fragments for research, diagnostics, and therapeutic manufacturing, including custom nucleic acid products and proteomics tools. Produced via specialized manufacturing and delivered to research and clinical customers.

products.name: Industrial and Process Filtration, Separation, and Purification Products
products.description: Filtration consumables and hardware for removing contaminants from liquids and gases in industrial applications such as microelectronics, oil refineries, power generation, and food and beverage processing. These are manufactured products delivered to industrial and commercial customers.

products.name: Clinical Diagnostics Systems and Consumables
products.description: Instruments, consumables, software, and services for clinical diagnostic testing in hospitals, laboratories, and critical care settings, including systems for disease diagnosis, monitoring, and management. These are regulated medical devices and consumables, manufactured and delivered to healthcare providers.

products.name: Molecular Diagnostics Systems
products.description: Biomedical testing instruments, systems, software, and consumables enabling DNA-based testing for organisms and genetic diseases, automating sample preparation, amplification, and detection for laboratory and point-of-care use. These are regulated, manufactured systems delivered to healthcare and laboratory customers.

products.name: Acute Care and Pathology Diagnostics Solutions
products.description: Instruments, consumables, and software for acute care diagnostics (e.g., blood gases, electrolytes, cardiac markers) and anatomical pathology (e.g., pathology lab workflow, specimen analysis), used in laboratory and point-of-care environments. These are manufactured, regulated medical devices and software delivered to healthcare providers.

products.name: Hotel Management Services
products.description: Operation and management of hotels for third-party owners under long-term contracts, providing day-to-day management, staffing, and operational oversight. Delivered through in-person human labor and regulated hospitality infrastructure.

products.name: Hotel Franchising and Licensing
products.description: Licensing of Hilton's brands, trademarks, and operating systems to hotel owners, who operate the properties independently while adhering to Hilton standards. Delivered via contractual agreements and brand support, not direct operations.

products.name: Owned and Leased Hotel Operations
products.description: Direct ownership or leasing and operation of hotels, generating revenue from room sales, food and beverage, and other guest services. Requires physical assets, in-person labor, and regulated hospitality infrastructure.

products.name: Timeshare and Vacation Ownership
products.description: Offering branded timeshare properties and vacation ownership opportunities, primarily through Hilton Grand Vacations, under long-term license agreements. Delivered via real estate sales and ongoing property management.

products.name: Guest Loyalty Program (Hilton Honors)
products.description: A global guest loyalty program that rewards members for stays at Hilton properties and strategic partner hotels, offering points redeemable for stays and other goods/services. Delivered digitally and through partnerships.

products.name: Strategic Partnerships and Co-Branded Credit Card Programs
products.description: Licensing Hilton brands and loyalty program access to strategic partners, including co-branded credit card providers and partner hotels, generating fees and expanding customer reach. Delivered via contractual partnerships and digital integration.

products.name: Fire Apparatus Vehicles
products.description: Custom-designed and manufactured fire trucks and related vehicles, including pumpers, aerial trucks, tanker trucks, rescues, and aircraft rescue firefighting vehicles, built at scale in dedicated manufacturing facilities and sold primarily to municipalities and government agencies.

products.name: Ambulance Vehicles
products.description: Manufacture and sale of highly customized ambulances (Type I, II, and III) for emergency medical services, built on various chassis types and tailored to customer specifications, delivered through direct and dealer channels.

products.name: Terminal Trucks
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of custom-built terminal tractors used to move trailers and containers within cargo yards, warehouses, intermodal facilities, and ports, produced in specialized facilities and distributed via direct and dealer networks.

products.name: Industrial Sweepers
products.description: Manufacture and sale of industrial sweepers for cleaning and preparation in road construction and paving industries, including both three- and four-wheel models, with significant aftermarket parts sales.

products.name: Motorized Recreational Vehicles (RVs)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of motorized recreational vehicles, including Class A, Class B, Class C, and Super C RVs, built on various chassis and equipped with living amenities, sold through a national dealer network.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services
products.description: Provision and sale of aftermarket parts and maintenance services for specialty vehicles and RVs, including remounting services for ambulances, supported by dedicated warehouses and service centers.

products.name: Custom Molded Fiberglass Products
products.description: Production and sale of custom molded fiberglass components for RVs and other industrial markets, manufactured by Goldshield Fiberglass and supplied both internally and to external customers.

products.name: Loyalty Platform Services
products.description: A proprietary digital loyalty platform (Society Pass) that enables merchants to issue and consumers to earn and redeem loyalty points across various subsidiaries, leveraging a cloud-based software infrastructure. Delivered digitally via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Online Lifestyle E-Commerce Platform
products.description: An online marketplace (Leflair) in Vietnam offering high-end brands across categories such as apparel, accessories, health & beauty, and home & lifestyle, with personalized promotions and integrated delivery or pickup options. Delivered via digital platform with physical product fulfillment.

products.name: Mobile Telecommunications Services
products.description: A Singapore-based online telecommunications reseller platform (Gorilla) providing international mobile data, calls, roaming, and SMS services to consumers, with network coverage in over 150 countries. Delivered digitally via mobile and online channels.

products.name: Digital Marketing and Media Services
products.description: Digital advertising and influencer marketing services (Thoughtful Media Group) that create and distribute campaigns across a multi-channel network, leveraging technology tools and local market expertise. Delivered digitally to advertisers and content creators in SEA and the US.

products.name: Online Travel Agency Services
products.description: Online travel booking and reservation services (Nusatrip Group) for flights and hotels, serving both corporate and retail customers in SEA, with access to over 500 airlines and 200,000 hotels globally. Delivered digitally via web and mobile platforms.

products.name: Food Delivery Services
products.description: Online food delivery platforms (Pushkart, Handycart, Mangan) operating in the Philippines and Vietnam, enabling consumers to order meals from various vendors for home or office delivery. Delivered via digital platforms with physical delivery logistics.

products.name: High-Performance Photodetectors and Photodetector Arrays
products.description: Semiconductor devices manufactured using compound semiconductor materials on large-diameter substrates, enabling cost-effective, high-sensitivity photodetectors and arrays for imaging and sensing applications in mobile devices, automotive, defense, and other sectors. Production involves advanced wafer-scale manufacturing and integration with mass-market microelectronics processes.

products.name: Heterogeneous Integration Technology for Nano-Scale Semiconductors
products.description: Development and delivery of semiconductor integration technology that enables combining compound semiconductors with advanced-node silicon for applications in AI, mobile, and wireless networking. Delivered through engineering development contracts and partnerships with government and commercial customers.

products.name: Quantum Dot Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs)
products.description: Design and development of advanced photonic integrated circuits using quantum dot technology on silicon substrates, targeting next-generation space, aerospace, and quantum computing applications. Delivered via government contracts and R&D services.

products.name: Custom Semiconductor Wafer and Chip Prototyping Services
products.description: Provision of R&D, prototyping, and small-volume manufacturing services for semiconductor wafers and chips, including engineering sample evaluations and non-recurring engineering (NRE) development for external customers in various industries.

products.name: Coffee Creamers
products.description: Powdered and liquid coffee creamers made with plant-based, organic, and functional ingredients such as mushrooms, produced via mixing and packaging of sourced raw materials at third-party facilities. Delivered as shelf-stable powders or refrigerated liquids through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Coffee, Tea, and Hot Chocolate Products
products.description: A range of traditional and functional beverage products including whole bean, ground, and K-cup coffees, instant lattes, protein coffee, teas, and hot chocolate, often incorporating functional mushrooms and superfoods. Produced by blending, roasting, and packaging, and sold through retail and online channels.

products.name: Hydration and Beverage Enhancing Products
products.description: Powdered coconut water drink mixes and plant-based beverage enhancers such as greens, reds, and mushroom supplements, formulated for hydration and nutrition. Manufactured by blending and packaging powders, distributed via retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Snacks and Functional Foods
products.description: Protein and energy bars, oatmeal, and other functional snacks, including on-the-go superfood bites and organic dried berries, produced with clean, minimally processed ingredients. Manufactured and packaged for retail and online sales.

products.name: Healthy Baking Products
products.description: Organic baking ingredients such as fairtrade cacao powders, nibs, and wafers, formulated for at-home baking with clean, minimally processed ingredients. Produced and packaged for consumer use in baking, distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Wellness Staples
products.description: Superfoods used daily in smoothies, bowls, and meal preparation, including chia seeds, matcha powder, and acai powder. Sourced, minimally processed, and packaged for retail and online sale.

products.name: Motor Fuel Distribution
products.description: Distribution of branded and unbranded motor fuels (gasoline, diesel, etc.) to dealers, distributors, commission agents, company-operated retail sites, and commercial customers. Involves large-scale procurement from refiners, inventory management, and delivery via pipeline, truck, rail, and marine logistics.

products.name: Convenience Retail Operations
products.description: Operation of company-owned and operated convenience retail facilities, offering fuel and a range of merchandise (including regulated products like alcohol and tobacco) to consumers. Requires in-person labor, inventory management, and compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Petroleum Product Distribution (Non-Fuel)
products.description: Distribution and sale of other petroleum products such as marine fuel, aviation fuel, propane, lubricating oil, and heating fuels to commercial, industrial, and governmental customers. Involves bulk purchasing, storage, and delivery logistics.

products.name: Race Fuels Manufacturing and Distribution
products.description: Manufacture and sale of specialized race fuels at a dedicated facility, distributed to motorsports and related customers. Involves physical manufacturing and regulated distribution.

products.name: Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of transportation services for refined products, crude oil, and ammonia via an integrated network of pipelines. Includes storage and throughput services for third-party customers, regulated by federal and state agencies.

products.name: Terminal Storage and Transmix Processing Services
products.description: Operation of terminals providing storage, blending, and transmix processing (separating off-specification mixtures into merchantable products) for refined products. Services are offered to support internal distribution and to third-party customers.

products.name: Refined Products Manufacturing (Refining)
products.description: Refining of crude oil and bio-feedstocks into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and other products at the Burnaby Refinery. Products are sold through retail, commercial, and direct channels. Requires regulated, capital-intensive physical infrastructure.

products.name: International Fuel Distribution and Convenience Retail
products.description: Distribution of fuel and operation of convenience retail outlets in international markets, primarily through the Parkland acquisition, spanning 26 countries in the Americas and the Caribbean. Involves local subsidiaries, logistics, and retail operations.

products.name: Retail Electricity Supply
products.description: Genie Energy purchases electricity on wholesale markets and resells it to residential and small business customers in deregulated U.S. markets through its retail energy providers. Delivery and billing are handled by local utilities, while Genie manages customer acquisition and pricing.

products.name: Retail Natural Gas Supply
products.description: Genie Energy purchases natural gas on wholesale markets and resells it to residential and small business customers in deregulated U.S. markets via its retail energy providers. Local utilities handle delivery and billing, while Genie manages procurement and customer relationships.

products.name: Green Energy Products (Electricity and Natural Gas)
products.description: Genie Energy offers green electricity (matched with renewable energy certificates) and green natural gas (matched with carbon offsets) to customers in many markets, leveraging certificates and offsets to provide renewable or lower-carbon options.

products.name: Utility-Scale Solar Energy Generation
products.description: Through Genie Solar, Genie Energy develops, constructs, owns, and operates small utility-scale solar generation projects, including community solar, selling generated electricity to the grid or customers. This involves physical project development, construction, and asset management.

products.name: Community Solar Customer Acquisition and Marketing
products.description: CityCom Solar markets community solar and alternative energy products, providing customer acquisition solutions for community solar projects and complementary services, primarily through direct-to-consumer marketing.

products.name: Energy Procurement and Advisory Services
products.description: Diversegy provides energy procurement advisory services to industrial, commercial, and municipal customers, acting as an intermediary to secure favorable energy contracts and offering ancillary energy services in both deregulated and regulated markets.
